biggest_catch: Walmart does not match any competitor's price — bringing an Amazon or Target ad to the register gets you nothing.
catches: Competitor price matching ended in 2019 (register matching ended 2017; Savings Catcher discontinued May 2019).
The only live match: Walmart stores match Walmart.com's own price — not Amazon, Target, or Best Buy.
Savings Catcher receipt-scan rebates are gone permanently.
Outdated articles still describe the old Ad Match policy — ignore them.

c1.evidence: thestreet.com: 'No, Walmart ended price matching in 2019'; usdollarpantry.com (2026): 'it no longer matches competitor ads or other retailers' prices... that option is gone company-wide'; dontpayfull.com: 'In-store matches Walmart.com only. No competitor matching anywhere.'

maximize: Don't waste a trip trying to price-match competitors at Walmart. The live alternatives: (1) Walmart stores still match Walmart.com's own lower price — check the app in-store before checkout. (2) Use Target or Best Buy price matching instead (both verified live in this lane). (3) For Walmart specifically, stack manufacturer coupons + Rollbacks + clearance, which is where the real savings are now.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Walmart's competitor price match (in-store Ad Match + Savings Catcher) ended 2017-2019. Included as a reject so the catalog never promises competitor matching at Walmart. Adjacent live fact: in-store matching of Walmart.com prices still works.

s5.note: Discontinuation confirmed by thestreet.com, dontpayfull.com, usdollarpantry.com.
